attribution_limitations: Source conflict on remission depth over the same period: the text states complete remission maintained for more than 43 months (also the Introduction and Discussion) and the abstract nonexistent disease, while the Figure 2 caption reports marked regression with minimal residual abnormalities and near-complete radiologic remission on scans dated March 2024 to April 2025, inside that period. Both sides are review_only; no post-treatment biopsy was done. Do not resolve which remission depth applies.

Durations printed without a shared anchor: 46 months overall survival (abstract) and complete remission for more than 43 months (text). Start points are not stated. Do not derive calendar dates or the current vital status from these durations.
Weight loss is printed as "intentional weight loss"; wording kept literal. Do not infer whether the weight loss was intended.
First-line regimen printed "FOLOX" once and "FOLFOX" elsewhere; treated as a print artefact of FOLFOX. Do not infer drug components beyond the printed name.

Figure 2 caption calls the scans of June 21, 2022, November 2, 2022 and January 5, 2023 "initial scans" although maintenance therapy started in May 2022, before the first of them by calendar date. The caption does not say these were pre-treatment baseline scans; do not infer the status of the metastases at therapy start.

No FOLFOX stop date and no interval between the FOLFOX stop and the May 2022 maintenance start are stated; the stop is ordered before the plan only by "necessitated" and "Taking into account ... the lack of tolerance". Do not infer a treatment-free interval or a stop date.
The Figure 2 caption prints "multiple billboard metastases"; the term is kept literally and is not reinterpreted as any other descriptor (for example lobar distribution).

Microsatellite stability, low tumor mutational burden and PD-L1 CPS <1 are introduced with "Molecular profiling also suggested"; the next paragraph states them without hedging ("Molecular analysis showed an immune-cold pattern"), so they are kept as results.
